title: Row ids
summary: Entity rows are keyed by TypeIDs that every device agrees on.

requirements.text: Every entity table is keyed by a TypeID: a per-table prefix and a UUID, `note_01jd4x8m2kf7r9q3vz5w6t0hyc`.
Tables without a prefix use a natural key, and no table uses an auto-increment integer.
A table's prefix never changes once rows exist.
